purpose: Validate individual P1 run-result records before they can enter comparative analysis.

checks: all required run-result fields present
enum values valid
started_at <= ended_at
run_id unique within analysis set
task_id/base_sha/treatment/shaping match frozen run spec
executor identity and model/runtime version observable
authoritative evidence reference resolvable
candidate artifact reference resolvable or explicitly classified missing
pricing source/date recorded for paid remote execution
environment identity sufficient to reproduce the run class
missing telemetry never coerced to zero
all consumed resources retained for YES, NO, and INCONCLUSIVE outcomes
token partitions are non-negative when present
monetary cost is non-negative when present
free/local execution does not silently imply zero total cost
cache state and price schedule are attributable when used
oracle_result YES requires task satisfaction plus preservation/regression plus harness validity
oracle_result NO can support treatment failure only when failure_class is PRODUCT_FAILURE
HARNESS_FAILURE, ORACLE_DEFECT, ENVIRONMENT_DRIFT, ambiguous attribution, or mandatory telemetry absence imply INCONCLUSIVE for affected claim
provider/resource failures remain accounted but do not silently become product failure

primary_analysis_rule: A run may enter TOTAL_SYSTEM_TOKENS / VERIFIED_SOLVED_TASK only when total-system token accounting is complete enough for the claimed comparison and the run passes V1-V4.
limited_analysis_rule: A run with explicit telemetry missingness may remain in solve/failure/provider-availability summaries if those summaries do not require the missing metric.
immutability_rule: Validation may classify or exclude a run from a metric; it must never rewrite observed run data to improve comparability.
